title: rfe-creator work-item type descriptor (types/<type>/type.yaml), schema_version 1
description: One descriptor per work-item type. It is the single source of every type-keyed literal the pipeline consumes (design-proposals/work-item-types-unified.md section 3.2; worked example section 8.2). At PR-1 the descriptors are inert: scripts/ do not import the registry yet and tests/ pin every live registry dict against descriptor projections. The vocabulary is closed (additionalProperties false) except for data-keyed maps whose KEYS are data rather than vocabulary: conventions.labels, schema.task.extra_fields, schema.review.extra_fields, eval.thresholds (Q20), plus the value-typed maps reporting.criterion_labels / criterion_short_labels / before_score_name_map, schema.task.priority.map_to_tracker and inputs[].gate.any_of[].fields. Fields marked RESERVED have no consumer in rfe-creator at v1; they exist so sibling pipelines' descriptors need no migration and so the shape is frozen before schema_version 1 is frozen. Evolution inside a major version is additive only.
$comment: Deployment binding override (design section 3.2.1). identity.<tracker> is the DEFAULT binding. type_registry.Descriptor.binding() computes the EFFECTIVE binding by overlaying the type-scoped environment variables RFE_CREATOR_BINDING_<TYPE>_{PROJECT,ISSUE_TYPE,LOCAL_PREFIX} (TYPE upper-cased; the workspace rfe-creator.yaml `bindings.<type>.<tracker>` form is reserved for PR-3). Overridable fields are binding-only: project, issue_type, key_prefixes (write prefix derived as '<PROJECT>-' when project is overridden; the descriptor prefixes are kept as read prefixes), query_default (re-rendered by the adapter), link types, state_map, parent_key_patterns, optionally local_prefix. NEVER judgement content, dirs, schema, rubric, eval. Rules: (a) zero-config default preserved, no required environment variable; (b) the section 3.3 uniqueness lint runs on EFFECTIVE bindings, and no type's local_prefix stem may equal any effective project key; (c) resolve prints the override (PR-3); (d) the dry-run sentinel is binding-derived (<PROJECT>-DRY); (e) run reports and snapshot metadata record the effective binding; (f) the Jira adapter contributes a generic key grammar to detect() as a rung AFTER every type's local_id_pattern and key_prefixes; (g) TRUST BOUNDARY: in headless and CI runs an override is honoured only from the environment (protected CI variables), never from a workspace file the checkout could carry; the effective (project, issue_type) pair is printed at resolve time and checked against the registered bindings before the first tracker write; an untrusted source or an unregistered pair is a hard failure, not a warning. DRAFT- is not adopted at v1.

schema_version.description: Descriptor schema major version. v1 only; a bump means an incompatible change to this file's shape.

type.description: Type name. MUST equal the directory name types/<type>/; used as the argparse --type choice and as the schema-name stem (<type>-task, <type>-review).

entity.description: Singular display noun (split_submit entity_name; generate_review_pdf report_title derives '<entity> Review & Remediation Report').

kind.description: RESERVED. Pipeline kind, selects the engine's phase table. v1's engine accepts only work-item (the review/split graph rfe and initiative share); strategy and decomposition are recorded for the sibling pipelines (strat-creator, epic-creator) so their descriptors need no migration. No consumer in rfe-creator.

inputs.description: RESERVED (design section 3.7). How items of this type are DERIVED from an upstream type. Two requesters exist (strat-creator <- rfe via Cloners; epic-creator <- strategy via parent), which satisfies the second-requester rule for the SCHEMA; rfe-creator ships NO gate evaluator.

produces.description: RESERVED (design section 3.7). Downstream types this pipeline derives, and the label it sets on the input when done.

summary.description: One-sentence description of what belongs to this type.

driver.description: Who typically originates the item (e.g. customer, engineering).

classification.description: Optional at v1; consumed by interactive create (design section 6 stage 1) and the mis-filed report signal (stage 2) from PR-7.

originals.description: Raw tracker descriptions at fetch time; baseline for conflict detection.

reviews.description: Review, feasibility, dimension and split-status files.

dirs.description: Artifact directories in the 'artifacts/<dir>' form (Q13). Consumers that want the bare form ('rfe-tasks') use Descriptor.dirs(form='bare').

enabled.description: Whether rebuild_index runs after submit/split (artifacts/rfes.md analog).

comments.description: Whether the FETCH step produces a <id>-comments.md companion. This flag means 'fetch produces one', never 'rename may drop the suffix' (rename handles -comments.md for every type).

removed_context.description: Whether review may produce a <id>-removed-context.yaml companion.

extra_suffixes.description: Additional companion suffixes on this type's id (e.g. a decompose kind lists -decomposition).

extra_fields.description: Batch-input keys beyond the shared base {prompt, priority, labels, clarifying_context} (validate_batch_input KNOWN_FIELDS delta).

repo_path.description: Path relative to the plugin root (the working directory, design section 3.5.1). Never absolute, never escaping the root.

tracker.description: Discriminator. Exactly one binding block (identity.jira | identity.github) is present and it must match this value (design section 3.6).

local_prefix.description: Tracker-neutral write prefix for NEW local ids (next_rfe_id --prefix uses the dash-less stem). Overridable per deployment (section 3.2.1).

local_id_pattern.description: AUTHORITATIVE local-id grammar: an anchored regex (must start with ^ and end with $). Source of the base-schema local_id patterns. detect() full-matches every type's local_id_pattern BEFORE any tracker key grammar and prefers the most specific match, so a composite sibling id such as RHAISTRAT-1234-E001 can never prefix-resolve to a RHAISTRAT- type. Write it single-quoted in YAML with ONE backslash per escape ('^RFE-\d+$').

id_field.description: Frontmatter field holding the item id (rfe_id, initiative_id).

jira_binding.description: The Jira binding. (project, issue_type) IS the type identity under the jira tracker; the cross-type lint enforces per-tracker binding uniqueness on EFFECTIVE bindings.

project.description: Jira project key. Overridable per deployment.

issue_type.description: Jira issue type NAME (issues are created by name, jira_utils.create_issue). Overridable per deployment.

key_prefixes.description: Jira key grammar. [0] is the WRITE prefix; every entry is a READ/detect prefix (subsumes the ADR's also_reads). An overridden project prepends '<PROJECT>-' and keeps these as read prefixes.

split_link_type.description: Issue-link type name used between a split parent and its children.

approved.description: Target status name for the approve policy (matched case-insensitively by jira_utils.transition_issue).

close_superseded.description: How a split parent is closed once its children exist. `transition` is the TARGET STATUS NAME matched case-insensitively; closure is skipped with a warning when the workflow has no such transition.

ready.description: RESERVED. Optional on-deck state a passing item is moved to (design section 3.4 workflow-states note).

state_map.description: The ONLY tracker transitions the tool performs, declared per binding. Everything past 'ready' (In Progress -> Done, per-column exit criteria) is refused.

priority.description: Tracker-side priority vocabulary, fixed per binding not per type (design section 3.4). Optional; when absent the Jira default ['Blocker','Critical','Major','Normal','Minor','Undefined'] applies. schema.task.priority.map_to_tracker maps the task-side vocabulary onto it.

github_binding.description: The GitHub Issues binding, shaped per design section 8.6. Nothing ships it at v1: the adapter, emulator and CI wiring are first-requester work (section 3.6). Each degradation is declared here, never silent.

repo.description: Exactly one owner/repo per type (v1 rule).

type_label.description: Default: the type is a label on the issue.

issue_type.description: Opt-in: an org-level native issue type.

kind.description: How the type is expressed on the repo: exactly one of type_label | issue_type.

alias_prefix.description: Filesystem-safe key alias: artifact keys and filenames are <ALIAS>-<number>; the frontmatter tracker_ref (owner/repo#123) is the truth.

labels_defined.description: GitHub labels are repo objects: definitions the adapter's ensure-labels setup step creates, not just names.

priority.description: Declared degradation: GitHub has no priority field. 'omit' or a label taxonomy.

components.description: Declared degradation: no components; a label namespace or omit.

emulator.description: Declared degradation for the emulator-seed provider obligation until a GitHub emulator exists.

conventions.description: Tracker-NEUTRAL conventions (labels are concepts on every tracker).

type_label.description: Human label used in messages ('No {type_label} task files found.' is byte-stable for rfe).

label_prefix.description: Namespace prefix of every label this pipeline emits.

comment_prefix.description: Marker prefixed to every tracker comment the tool writes. PUBLISHED CONTRACT (R7): downstream pipelines string-match it.

removed_context_preamble.description: First line of the removed-context comment. PUBLISHED CONTRACT (R7): strat-creator's refine step string-matches it. Frozen; changed only with a downstream migration note.

query_default.description: Default selection query in the language owned by identity.tracker (JQL for jira). No consumer at PR-1 (queries arrive via --jql); re-rendered by the adapter under a binding override.

parent_key_patterns.description: Unanchored alternatives accepted for the task parent_key field; the task schema pattern is '^(' + '|'.join(patterns) + ')$'. Authoritative for the batch validator too once PR-3 reconciles them (today validate_batch_input is narrower: known divergence).

labels.description: OPEN map: reserved keys are typed when present, types may add keys (string values, or a map of string values). Reserved defaults are '<label_prefix>-<suffix>' but the shipped descriptors spell every value out.

rubric_pass.description: PUBLISHED CONTRACT (R7). The exported readiness signal downstream types gate on; excluded by the jql_query default wrapper. Default <prefix>-autofix-rubric-pass.

ignore.description: Opt-out label: excluded by the jql_query default wrapper AND the snapshot/bootstrap hard filter. Default <prefix>-ignore.

split_quarantine.description: Failed-split quarantine: snapshot/bootstrap hard filter only. Default <prefix>-split-quarantine.

split_child_marker.description: A TEMPLATE, not a value: creation-time recovery marker on split children. Placeholders {parent} and {child_id} are LOWER-CASED before rendering; {fingerprint} = sha256(cleaned child markdown)[:12]. Default <prefix>-split-child-{parent}-{child_id}-{fingerprint}.

auto_created.description: Set on every item the tool creates. Default <prefix>-auto-created.

auto_revised.description: Set when the tool revised the body before submit. Default <prefix>-auto-revised.

split_original.description: Set on a split parent when it is closed. Default <prefix>-split-original.

feasibility.description: Outcome labels of the feasibility dimension; key order is the review-schema feasibility enum. Defaults <prefix>-feasibility-pass|fail|unknown.

alignment.description: Outcome labels of the alignment dimension; only when an alignment dimension is declared. Defaults <prefix>-alignment-strong|partial|weak.

processing.description: RESERVED for other kinds (lock label); no rfe-creator consumer.

human_sign_off.description: RESERVED for other kinds; no rfe-creator consumer.

from_field.description: Task frontmatter field whose value fills {value}.

pattern.description: Label template containing {value}; the value is inserted verbatim (no transform at v1).

default.description: Default written by apply_defaults. OMIT the key (rather than default: null) for a field that must never be written into existing artifacts (Q4).

fields.description: Nested spec for type: dict (frontmatter.py set takes dot paths).

field_spec.description: One artifact_utils.SCHEMAS field specification; nested dict specs are supported.

extra_fields.description: OPEN map of task fields beyond the shared base (title, priority, status, parent_key, original_labels, local_id, <id_field>, type, tracker_ref).

map_to_tracker.description: task value -> tracker priority name; {} means the identity map.

priority.description: RESERVED, no consumer. The TASK-side priority vocabulary; today the enum lives in artifact_utils.SCHEMAS and the pin test asserts equality. An identity map ({}) means the task vocabulary is the tracker vocabulary.

score_fields.description: Rubric criteria, in display order: the single source for scores/before_scores fields, the verify_phase error stub (scores.<f>=0), run-report and PDF criterion keys, and compare_review_outputs.

extra_fields.description: OPEN map of review fields beyond the shared base.

extra_scores.description: Optional nullable scores that are NOT rubric criteria and are excluded from the total (e.g. jtbd_alignment, PR #100). Schema only at PR-1.

extra_rules.description: Declarative post-review rules (today a prompt rule, e.g. alignment weak -> needs_attention). Recorded, unpinned; the consumer is the PR-5 launcher.

stages.description: OPEN list of stage names validated (from PR-5) against registered generic skills; a type may ship fewer. Today: create, review, submit, split, auto-fix, speedrun; PR #133 adds dupes, merge.

bootstrap.description: Script the SETUP phase runs from the plugin root.

args.description: Extra argv after the script path (e.g. ['--type', 'rfe']).

required.description: Whether a failure is fatal. No consumer at PR-1: SETUP runs its commands concurrently and only logs exit codes.

context_sources.description: DESCRIPTIVE at PR-1: SETUP is still a hardcoded command list in pipeline_state.py; the projection is SETUP.commands[i] == 'bash <bootstrap> <args...>'.

poll_prefix.description: Prefix of poll-phase names (check_review_progress PHASE_CHECKS keys, pipeline_state poll_phase) and of the review report filename ('<poll_prefix>review-report.html', Q15). '' is grandfathered for type rfe only.

state_prefix.description: Prefix of tmp/ state files ('tmp/<state_prefix>speedrun-all-ids.txt', 'tmp/<state_prefix>{review,split,autofix}-config.yaml'). '' is grandfathered for type rfe only.

scorer_agent.description: Subagent type for the ASSESS-family phases; the agent file agents/<scorer_agent>.md must exist in the assess checkout (gate 2). Per type until the one-scorer collapse (design section 7.2).

prompts.description: Per-type judgement files consumed via launcher vars from PR-5 (design section 4.2). Optional at v1; at PR-1 they point at today's live skill paths (Q1) and gate 1 checks that each exists.

dimensions.description: Parallel review dimensions launched in the ASSESS wave, in order.

resplit.description: check_right_sized's RESPLIT-children threshold (queue a child for re-split when <score_field> < below). NOT the review-time split rule, which lives in review_rules. Default right_sized / 2.

name.description: Poll phase is '<poll_prefix><name>'; output file is '<dirs.reviews>/<id>-<name>.md'.

prompt.description: Prompt/skill file the dimension agent reads.

blocking.description: Whether the ASSESS wave waits on the dimension (wait-for-wave --also-phase). Descriptive at PR-1: no script reads it.

oneOf.description: Run only when the task frontmatter field starts with prefix (today's has_rhaistrat_parent).
Run only when the context path exists (PR #100's JTBD dimension).

condition.description: Closed condition vocabulary. An issue-type test (parent_is_outcome) is a named hook, deliberately not expressible here.

setup.description: Optional bootstrap script for the dimension's context.

skip_stub.description: Frontmatter written to the dimension output when the condition is false (the engine writes both keys).

rubric.description: Assess-side rubric source. Either an external assess repo pinned to an immutable commit (ref) or the D3 alternative repo: self with a content hash (rubric_version).

repo.description: owner/repo or its https://github.com/ URL (the shipped descriptors carry the URL verbatim because bootstrap-assess-rfe.sh holds it).

ref.description: Immutable commit SHA (tags move). QUOTE it in YAML: an all-digit or digits+e ref would otherwise parse as a number. Documentary at PR-1; the bootstrap verifies it from PR-2.

path.description: Rubric file path inside the assess checkout (gate 2 checks it under --assess-dir).

export.description: Where the rubric is exported for authors (artifacts/<type>-rubric.md), or null when nothing exports it. Not required to exist.

repo.description: D3: the rubric is embedded in this repo.

rubric_version.description: Content hash of the rubric file.

mode.description: RESERVED. none for kinds without snapshots (they declare processed_gate instead).

prefix.description: Snapshot file prefix. Never empty; the cross-type lint requires prefixes to be pairwise not prefix-of-each-other.

report_prefix.description: Run-report filename prefix (generate_run_report output_prefix, bootstrap_snapshot). '' is grandfathered for type rfe only.

processed_gate.description: RESERVED. How a kind with mode none decides an input was already processed (e.g. remote_children).

item_key.description: Run-report key holding the per-item entries (per_rfe, per_initiative).

criterion_labels.description: score field -> long label; key order = display order. Map over schema.review.score_fields.

criterion_short_labels.description: score field -> short label; when a key is omitted the long label applies.

before_score_name_map.description: Alias (as written by the scorer) -> score field; key order verbatim.

reporting.description: Derived, not fields: report_title from display.entity; run-report filename from snapshot.report_prefix; review-report filename from pipeline.poll_prefix; pass_threshold 7 is scoring machinery.

config.description: The committed eval config (generated from PR-4).

thresholds.description: OPEN map judge name -> threshold. AUTHORITATIVE for the generated eval config (design section 4.5).

annotations_extra.description: Type-specific expected_* annotation keys beyond the shared set.

from_type.description: Upstream type name (may be a peer pipeline's type, not necessarily registered here).

link_type.description: Issue-link type name when kind is clones or link (e.g. Cloners).

dependency_link_type.description: Link type used between sibling items derived from the same input (e.g. Blocks).

source_ref_field.description: Frontmatter field holding the upstream ref.

labels_any.description: Values may be literals or ${types.<t>.labels.<key>} references to a registered type's exported label.

fields.description: field id or display name -> accepted option names.

gate.description: Upstream readiness gate, evaluated by the CONSUMING pipeline (rfe-creator ships no evaluator).

attachment.description: Attachment filename template on the upstream issue (R7 convention '{key}-strategy.md').

label_on_input.description: Label this pipeline sets on the input once every produced item exists.
